retained_metadata.scope: Selected bodies rehashed as SHA256 and Git blobs and matched to retained metadata. Prior HTTPS GitHub/tree reconstruction receipt reused; no new network authentication or complete tree reconstruction performed.

projection_helper_shadowing.limit: Only these inspected same-name helpers are resolved; not complete MATLAB dispatch or archive/repository parity.

algebra.projected_variance: trace(Q transpose times C times Q)
algebra.spectrum: Descending eigenvalues of the covariance of the source data matrix; not percent explained, singular values, total trace or unsorted eigenvalues.
algebra.covariance_equivalence: The inspected single-trial caller assigns each supplied covariance from the same N matrix passed to the PCA helper. Actual N row membership still needs independent preparation.
algebra.numerator_denominator_rank: Exact eight source routes are encoded in BRANCHES; response-null and delay-potent use epoch-associated denominator ranks.

caller_support_limits: Stationary/moving matrices derive from selected trials and the movement mask. Delay/response matrices are built from all supplied input trials at nearest-index source epoch boundaries. No common trial mask is invented.
Source rank selection, trial/movement masks, normalization, biological unit order, source dispatch and publisher-final mapping remain unadmitted.

ci.dependency: NumPy must already be available in the selected CI environment. No runtime install occurs in this component.
ci.required_action: Sole integrator must enroll this new task-local test in an appropriate NumPy-enabled source check before publication.

rights: Independently authored arithmetic and controls; no upstream MATLAB bodies redistributed. Source notice/license terms remain with their original files.
